We must keep answer short and specific, address the customer directly. Provide steps.

function.arguments: {"message":"Hi! To build a report grouped by tag instead of status, go to **Reports → Custom → New report**. In the report builder, choose **Tag** as the “group‑by” dimension. The report will then show one row per tag (a ticket with multiple tags appears under each tag) with the usual metrics like count and average resolution time. You can save and schedule the custom report just like any built‑in report."}
